H_hierarchical.evidence: The walking controller is a sequential four-state gait FSM with ST, PS, SF, and SE; no parent state or nested sub-FSM is described.

G_guards_arith.evidence: The transition table uses sensor-threshold guards, including boolean OR guards combining thigh angular velocity with force and knee angle with force.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: States configure the hydraulic valve and motor subsystem; swing flexion generates a cadence-adaptive spline trajectory and uses PD tracking, while swing extension continues tracking and closes the valve.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: The paper discusses perturbation robustness and a passive extension aid under power failure, but gives no explicit fault state, recovery transition, or global escape path in the walking controller.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: State names and per-state actions appear in Section V, while the concrete transition guards are in Table II at the end of the paper.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Domain gait terms such as stance and swing are used, but the relevant state sequence, actions, and transition conditions are explicitly spelled out.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: Per-state actions are stated in the same walking-controller paragraph using explicit mappings such as ST closes the valve and SF generates/tracks a trajectory.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: Two guards combine variables with OR: thigh angular velocity or force, and knee angle or force.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: There is no composite parent state with its own entry, during, or exit behavior.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: No from-any-state fault, abort, or safe-state transition is declared.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No composite state or init pseudo-chain is present.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: There are two boolean-composed guards over sensor thresholds, enough for weak expression-IR advantage but not a broad SMT consistency case.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: No global forced transition or parent-level during aspect can collapse several substates.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Outputs are concrete effector commands to the hydraulic valve and motor controller, not abstract notifications or channel-independent side effects.

key_nl_quotes: four states: Stance, Pre-swing, Swing flexion, Swing extension
PS to SF: Thigh angular velocity > 0 or Force < 50 N
one_line_pitch: A flat but action-rich gait EFSM whose sensor OR guards and per-state valve/motor control stress guard and action extraction more than hierarchy or recovery.
rationale: This is a meaningful stress-test for the weakest baseline dimensions because the controller has explicit multi-sensor boolean guards and substantial state-dependent actuation behavior. The main limitation is structural: it is a flat four-state FSM with no hierarchy, no fault-recovery layer, and only moderate baseline-trap density. It is therefore useful as a backup guard/action benchmark rather than a top candidate for broad pyfcstm primitive advantage.
